content_planner_inputs.content_idea: Show three visible adjustments to one forest textured overshirt: wear it open, button it lightly, then check the collar, cuff, and hem.
content_planner_inputs.visual_direction: One continuous all-photographic HF outfit clip with three timed editorial overlays and no illustrated garments or fictional location changes.

content_planner_inputs.full_proposed_caption: One overshirt, three small styling moves. First, wear it open so the cream tee stays visible and the layer feels relaxed. Second, button it lightly to create a cleaner front line without pulling the fabric. Third, check the collar, cuff and hem, then stop when the layer sits cleanly. This video shows one outfit in one setting, not three different occasions. Save the fit check and try it with a layer you already own. Follow @budgetfitzz for budget-first menswear systems.

content_planner_inputs.hook: A realistic fit check, from shoulder to shoe.
content_planner_inputs.content_idea: Use the visible balanced outfit to check the shoulder line, tee hem, and straight trouser line without claiming a before-and-after transformation.
content_planner_inputs.visual_direction: One continuous all-photographic HF full-body clip with four timed editorial overlays and no illustrated garments or unsupported corrections.
content_planner_inputs.caption_direction: Describe the fit visible in the footage and label it as a mirror checklist, not a transformation.
content_planner_inputs.full_proposed_caption: Use this as a mirror checklist, not a before-and-after. First, check that the sleeve seam sits near the shoulder and the tee lies smoothly without pulling. Second, check that the tee hem finishes close to the waistband with enough length to move and no excess bunching. Third, follow the trouser line down to a clean ankle and shoe. Read the whole silhouette before buying another piece. Save the three checks and test them on an outfit you already own. Follow @budgetfitzz for practical fit guidance.
content_planner_inputs.cta: Save the three visible fit checks and try them in the mirror.
content_planner_inputs.baseline_insight: E03 + E09: education is more saveable and current video retention leaves room for faster, explicit progression.
